::: {#exr-absorption}
#### A rule with a redundant part

A server grants access to a user who is an administrator,
or who is an administrator and is on the office network.
Let $P$ be "the user is an administrator"
and $Q$ be "the user is on the office network".

Make a truth table for $P \lor (P \land Q)$.
In which rows does it have the same truth value as $P$?

:::
